verdict.rationale: HumanLayer's `humanlayer automation run` can be invoked from a cron machine or CI job to run one Cloud-visible session, implying recurring runs are possible via external schedulers, but there is no evidence of a native recurring-job scheduler or workflow trigger built into HumanLayer itself. Missing for 10: built-in cron/scheduling UI or config, documentation of automatic recurrence, and any first-party or community confirmation of scheduled workflows running reliably.
